deadline.value: Fall 2027 application deadline is February 15, 2027; later applications are accepted as space and funding permit.

also.quote: Later applications accepted as space and funding permit

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE is strongly recommended for international students.
gre_subject.quote: Chemistry GRE is strongly recommended for international students

supervisor.value: You cannot be accepted without a research supervisor who agrees to take you; apply online and then contact faculty.
supervisor.quote: Be advised that you cannot be accepted into the program without having a research supervisor.

funding.value: Chemistry PhD has a standard funding package for international students: CAD 46,180 per year for years 1-5 (fellowship, TA employment and research assistantship).
funding.quote: Annual Funding Summary Years 1 - 5 | International | York University Fellowship | Research Assistantship | Package Total | 46,180

entry_route.value: PhD applicants need a 2-year research-based MSc with a B+ average.
entry_route.quote: 2-year research-based Master of Science degree (B+ average)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 88 (tests before January 2026) or 4.5 on the new scale (from January 2026), per the program listing. The older department page cites 79-80 iBT and IELTS 6.6, so the two official pages disagree.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL (Internet-based) 88 (for tests taken prior to January 2026) or 4.5 (January 2026 and after)
